diff --git a/tests/pypto_test/csa_mpmd_tnd_20261021/run_case.py b/tests/pypto_test/csa_mpmd_tnd_20261021/run_case.py
index f69c74454..e74610648 100644
--- a/tests/pypto_test/csa_mpmd_tnd_20261021/run_case.py
+++ b/tests/pypto_test/csa_mpmd_tnd_20261021/run_case.py
@@ -42,9 +42,14 @@ def check_case(case):
     q, h = case["query_lengths"], case["history_lengths"]
     assert len(q) == len(h) == b and bc >= b
     assert all(1 <= n <= 6 for n in q) and all(n >= 0 for n in h)
-    assert sum(q) == case["valid_tokens"] <= case["token_capacity"] <= 6 * bc
-    assert len(case["query_start_loc"]) == bc + 1
-    assert case["query_start_loc"][-1] == case["token_capacity"]
+    assert sum(q) == case["valid_tokens"] <= case["token_capacity"]
+    bounds = case["query_start_loc"]
+    assert len(bounds) == bc + 1 and bounds[0] == 0
+    assert [end - begin for begin, end in zip(bounds[:b], bounds[1:b + 1])] == q
+    # Native ACLGraph可用一个失活请求承接任意长度的尾部padding。
+    # 真实query仍严格为S1～S6，dummy只要求边界单调且落在分配容量内。
+    assert all(begin <= end for begin, end in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]))
+    assert bounds[-1] == case["token_capacity"]
     assert case["seq_lens"] == [a + n for a, n in zip(h, q)] + [0] * (bc - b)
 
 
diff --git a/vllm_ascend/ops/pypto/deepseek_v4_flash_csa_spmd_tnd/policy.py b/vllm_ascend/ops/pypto/deepseek_v4_flash_csa_spmd_tnd/policy.py
index 58efc3c45..165a5ada3 100644
--- a/vllm_ascend/ops/pypto/deepseek_v4_flash_csa_spmd_tnd/policy.py
+++ b/vllm_ascend/ops/pypto/deepseek_v4_flash_csa_spmd_tnd/policy.py
@@ -132,8 +132,10 @@ def select_policy(
     values = (tokens, requests, max_query_tokens, max_seq_len)
     if any(type(v) is not int or v <= 0 for v in values):
         raise ValueError("tokens/requests/max_query_tokens/max_seq_len须为已有的正整数描述符")
-    if tokens > requests * max_query_tokens:
-        raise ValueError("token容量超过请求容量×query上界；请绑定Native同一档描述符")
+    # tokens是图的行容量，max_query_tokens只约束有效请求。Native可将全部
+    # padding合并为一个失活请求，因此容量可以超过requests * max_query_tokens。
+    # 有效token/query的合法性由service_config.supported_descriptor检查；
+    # 此处只选资源策略，不回读Q/L，也不扩大真实query上界来迁就padding。
     cache_rows = max_seq_len // 4
     if cache_rows < 2048:
         raise NotImplementedError("完整动态SPMD的小历史Vector Score路径尚未接入")
diff --git a/vllm_ascend/ops/pypto/deepseek_v4_flash_csa_tnd/policy.py b/vllm_ascend/ops/pypto/deepseek_v4_flash_csa_tnd/policy.py
index a4a421c58..f2b3b5bab 100644
--- a/vllm_ascend/ops/pypto/deepseek_v4_flash_csa_tnd/policy.py
+++ b/vllm_ascend/ops/pypto/deepseek_v4_flash_csa_tnd/policy.py
@@ -87,8 +87,9 @@ def select_policy(
     values = (tokens, requests, max_query_tokens, max_seq_len)
     if any(type(v) is not int or v <= 0 for v in values):
         raise ValueError("tokens/requests/max_query_tokens/max_seq_len须为已有的正整数描述符")
-    if tokens > requests * max_query_tokens:
-        raise ValueError("token容量超过请求容量×query上界；请绑定Native同一档描述符")
+    # Native图可将全部padding合并为一个失活请求；tokens是行容量，不能
+    # 用有效请求的query上界限制它。有效token/query仍由共享服务入口检查，
+    # 本层仅选择资源策略，不读取设备Q/L或修改请求容量。
     cache_rows = max_seq_len // 4
     if cache_rows < 2048:
         raise NotImplementedError("TND 多 task 的短历史 Vector Score 路径尚未接入")
